newsitem.title: THAILAND: Krupp says MaK Machinenbau sale seen in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Krupp says MaK Machinenbau sale seen in Q4.

text.p: Germany's Krupp group expects to complete the sale of its diesel engine subsidiary Krupp MaK Machinenbau to Caterpillar Incorporated in the fourth quarter this year, a senior company executive said

Heribert J Wiedenhues, chairman of the executive board of Krupp Fordertechnik, a unit of Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp's plant making division Krupp Anlangenbau GmbH, said: "By Christmas it should be through. It has gone through in principle, we are into the nitty gritty.
Wiedenhues said during a visit to Thailand on Monday that the company expected to book a small amount of extraordinary profit from the sale by year end.
He said the deal was worth approximately twice the 700 million marks Krupp paid Hoechst AG last year for chemical plant builder Uhde group.
He said Krupp's attempts to sell its excavator and construction equipment subsidiary Orenstein & Koppel Aktiengesellscaft (O & K) were proving more difficult.
"People are a little bit reluctant to buy big manufacturing outlets in Germany," he added.
